## Checks

- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `python -m pytest` pass
- [ ] New behaviour comes with a test that fails without it
- [ ] No firmware or upload commands, and nothing uses the `d0ff` service
- [ ] No decompiled code, and no Bluetooth addresses in code, logs or screenshots
- [ ] Tested on a real watch: say which, or "not on a watch"
